limitations: Small exploratory panel, not a general benchmark.
Unedited means original GGUF weights. Existing production control vector and all runtime settings are retained.
Earlier original-weight tests used8192-token requests and server-inserted wrap-ups; they are not this baseline.
Shared production traffic and speculative decoding permit same-seed variation.
45-only historical requests used no positive cap, but naturally ended below75000.
The44+45+46 math result is user-interrupted, with an observed lower-bound token count and no final answer.

manual_reviews.basis: The response reasoning names the correct working-directory fix, but the emitted command repeats the same failed git diff operation without changing directory.

historical_loop_manual_reviews.basis: Changes to the correct repository, then inspects Git changes. This corrects the supplied working-directory failure; the literal grader required the git -C spelling. Original automatic score retained.
